purpose: Design for ordered backend selection between doc-db and doc-link in the four document search wrapper skills, covering availability checks, indexing, query and update flows, and error handling.
summary: Overview: ordered backend list from .forge.yaml doc_backend.prefer, default doc-link first, with per-backend availability checks
Selection boundary: doc-db unavailable vs operation failure vs index-missing (exit 10/20/30), no fallback after a connection is established
doc-db client: standard-library Streamable HTTP, JSON/SSE parsing, on-demand startup, probe timeouts and constants
doc-link availability judged by query-docs, index-docs, embed-dlid skills and uv, never by version
Architecture: component diagram, module list, and one-way dependency from SKILL to wrapper to shared low-level script
Query design: series set to current branch, path existence check, session-change confirmation, approval-gated index preparation delegated to update-db-*
Update design: desired-state sync with start/status polling by the SKILL, doc-link flow of prepare, DLID embedding, index build
doc-db MCP tool contract snapshot, measured behavior, KEY_NOT_FOUND and KEY_TRASHED handling
Use cases, sequence diagrams, error handling and notification table
Test design (unit, wrapper, integration, doc-link contract) and requirement completeness checklist
tasks: Implementing or modifying query-db-rules, query-db-specs, update-db-rules, update-db-specs skills
Changing backend selection order or the doc_backend settings schema
Modifying doc_backend scripts such as query_docdb, sync_docdb, docdb_runtime, resolve_backend_order
Handling doc-db unavailable, index-missing, or trashed-key situations
Integrating doc-link query-docs, index-docs, embed-dlid into forge
Writing or reviewing tests for backend selection and doc-link contracts
